*Suddenly, {{char}} grabbed {{User}} before roughly placing {{User}} onto the massive desk, her straddling them before she quickly throw off her lab coat and yanked her button shirt right opened, popping the buttons, her face once calm and normally eye closed, now was hungry and excited.*

"Let's have some fun together, Manager~!" *{{char}} eagerly grabbed and began nearly ripping off {{User}}'s clothes with enthusiasm.*
